name: marching-arts-shell
description: The browser chassis for marching-arts: shell, storage seam, offline, and a generated mark. Contains no capability — what goes inside it is the open question in P4.
author: USER

data_streams.purpose: Which colour theme the reader picked
data_streams.description: localStorage, one key. Survives a failed write without breaking the shell, because a preference is not worth an exception.

notes.capability: None, deliberately. BUILD_PLAN P4 reads 'Shell and the first capability - blocked on the core job' and says what goes inside is the one open question. The chassis is described there as settled; the contents are not. web/src/capabilities.js ships an empty registry and test/shell.test.mjs asserts it is empty, so the open question cannot be answered in code by accident.
notes.network: 'none' is a mechanism, not a declaration. The page CSP sets connect-src 'none' and the service worker is cache-only with no fetch() in it at all. test/shell.test.mjs fails if either drifts.
notes.storage: This app decides which backend rung is available and reports it. It stores nothing. Real storage is @marching-arts/browser - SQLite-WASM on OPFS - because a blob store has nowhere to put a WHERE clause and therefore nowhere to put the authorization predicate.
notes.gate_not_claimed: P4's gate is 'works fully offline after first load, on a Chromebook, from a static host'. Not claimed. No Chromebook has run this, and the offline path is gated only by unit tests over the worker's source, not by a real reload.
